understanding: Appendix scanning tutorial pairing an abdominal probe-position diagram with annotated transverse and longitudinal ultrasound examples.

tasks.question: In this transverse image, where is the marked appendix relative to the two marked iliac vessels?
tasks.reference_answer: It is shallower and farther to the right in the image.
tasks.visual_support: The appendix arrow points to the mid-right target while the two vessel arrowheads lie deeper at left.
tasks.answer_prefix_check: Their vertical and horizontal offsets are readable in the full frame.

tasks.reference_answer: The compact oval seen here becomes a longer dark profile running across the image.
tasks.visual_support: The annotation points to a compact profile at 330 and a horizontally extended profile at 331.

tasks.question: Before the appendix was marked, what did the bright border look like in the earlier cecum example?
tasks.reference_answer: It had an irregular bright border that dipped and rose across the center-right of the image.
tasks.visual_support: The labeled cecum frame shows a wavy hyperechoic boundary, absent from the current longitudinal illustration.
